comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Obtained at random from Glorious Mini Ticket item. Stats:

10 Disguise
Dye Trading +3
Sewing +2
Storage +2
EX Effect Increase sailing speed R6

Notes: It equips in the Weapon slot but does not count as an actual weapon so I think the 50 attack currently listed is a mistake. It also has no item effect to prevent durability loss, which is a shame. It's very cuddly though. Cheers, and great online voyaging to you and your dolphin friends.

Pic: www.gamecity.ne.jp/dol/topics_cms/campaign/10086.html
